description: Build from a script file of part(name, () => {...}) blocks (fill, hollow, walls, sphere, cylinder, roof, layers, mix, rotate, mirror...): build {project, file}. After editing the file call it again: only changed blocks are written. A new project needs origin. preview 'iso4': four corner views in one image. Guide: craftwire://docs/building.

file.description: Script path, relative to the hub's working directory.

part.description: Run only this part of the file.

name: build
